units.source_text: “什么呀，那以后过了十天了吧，可派出所没有来过什么消息……”

en.t: What do you mean? It has been ten days since then, has it not, but there has been no word from the police box...

units.source_text: 老头十分规矩地一字一顿慢慢确认，

en.t: the old man confirmed slowly and very properly, enunciating each word,

units.source_text: “过了十天，都还没有动静，那是怎么回事呢……”

en.t: Ten days have passed, and there is still no sign of anything happening. What is going on...
